Aviso.SoMestre: Only the GM can use the World Navigator.
Aviso.Offline: {nome} is offline: they will join "{mapa}" directly when they connect.
Aviso.SemModulo: The module did not respond in {nome}'s browser. Ask them to press F5.
Aviso.TodosPreCarregados: All online players have already preloaded this map.

Jog.ModuloSemResposta: The module did not respond in their browser. Ask them to press F5.

Grupo.Vazio: Select players with Ctrl and click "save as group".

Mapa.Buscar: Search map, folder, note or tag...
Mapa.SemMiniatura: No thumbnail — generate it from the ⋮ menu

Pasta.DentroDelaMesma: A folder cannot be placed inside itself.

Etq.DicaFiltro: Click to filter · right-click changes the color

Dica.Geral: Drag a player or a group onto a map (or click it, then click the map). Ctrl selects several; Esc clears. Drag maps onto others to reorder, or onto folders to move them. Double-click a map to view it.

Memoria.LiberarDica: Free memory: unload every map nobody is on
Memoria.SemSuporte: This Foundry version does not let the module unload textures.
Memoria.EmUso: Still loaded for whoever is on it: {nomes}.

Detalhes.NotaDica: Shown on the map card, only in the GM's window.
Detalhes.MusicaDica: Uses Foundry's native playlists, including those created by Audio Console. "Only whoever enters" plays in the browser of whoever is on the map and stops when they leave.

Chegada.Clique: Click the map where tokens should arrive. Esc or right-click cancels.

Portal.Pergunta: {token} stepped into a portal to {mapa}. Let them through?
Portal.SemMestre: The portal needs a connected GM.
Portal.Erro: The portal failed. Check the console (F12).

destino.label: Destination map
destino.hint: Where the token (and the players who own it) go when they enter this region.

regiao.label: Arrival region (optional)
regiao.hint: A region on the destination map. Empty: uses the map's arrival point (or its center).

confirmar.label: Ask the GM for confirmation
confirmar.hint: The GM must approve before the token goes through.

LembrarLugar.Nome: Players return to their last map
LembrarLugar.Dica: On joining or reloading (F5), the player opens directly on the last map they were on, without loading the active map first.

Transicao.Dica: When the GM sends a player to another map, shows the map's name (the name players see) while it loads.

LiberarAnterior.Dica: When changing maps, the map the person left is removed from memory (GM and players). Saves RAM, but going back loads everything again.

OcultarNavMestre.Nome: Hide the scene navigation bar for the GM
OcultarNavMestre.Dica: Hides Foundry's scene navigation for the GM, leaving only the World Navigator button.

OcultarNavJogadores.Nome: Hide the scene navigation bar for players
OcultarNavJogadores.Dica: Players no longer see (or use) scene navigation. Only the GM moves them between maps.

OcultarAbaCenas.Nome: Hide the Scenes tab in the sidebar
OcultarAbaCenas.Dica: Hides the Scenes tab on the right, since the World Navigator does everything it does. Maps are not deleted: turn it off to bring the tab back.

Gat.ErroAcao: Trigger "{gatilho}": action "{acao}" failed. Check the console (F12).
Gat.Longe: You are too far away to interact with that.
Gat.UsosDica: How many times it can fire. 0 = unlimited.
Gat.SemAcoes: No actions yet. Pick one below.
Gat.DistanciaDica: Maximum distance, in squares, between the player's token and the clicked point. 0 = from anywhere. The GM fires it with Alt+click.
Gat.PortasDica: On the Walls layer, select the doors on the map and click "Add selected".
Gat.TurnoDica: Turn: fires when the turn of a token inside the area starts or ends.
Gat.ArrasteAtor: Drag an actor from the sidebar here
Gat.SemOutros: There are no other triggers on this map.
Gat.AbraOMapa: Open the map "{mapa}" to select things on it.
Gat.SelecionePortas: Select one or more doors on the Walls layer.
Gat.SelecioneObjetos: Select tiles, tokens, lights, sounds, notes or drawings on the map (you can go layer by layer adding them).

AcaoDica.mover: Moves the token (with HP and effects) and the players who own it, with the transition screen.
AcaoDica.som: A short sound, like a creaking door, a button or a lever. Plays once.
AcaoDica.musica: Plays or stops a native playlist (including Audio Console ones) for the whole table.
AcaoDica.chat: You can use {token}, {jogador} and {mapa} in the text.
AcaoDica.diario: Opens the journal or page for whoever needs to see it. If permission is missing, the GM grants observer permission.
AcaoDica.imagem: Opens the image in a window for whoever needs to see it.
AcaoDica.camera: Pans the camera to the region. Zoom 0 keeps the current zoom.
AcaoDica.portas: Select the doors on the Walls layer and click "Add selected".
AcaoDica.visibilidade: Works with tiles, tokens, lights, sounds and drawings. Go layer by layer adding them.
AcaoDica.escuridao: 0 = bright day, 1 = total darkness. Duration in seconds.
AcaoDica.gatilho: "Run now" runs the other trigger's actions immediately, ignoring its "when".
AcaoDica.esperar: Pauses before the next action (e.g. lever sound, then the door opens).

Opc.jogadores: All player tokens on the map

Gat.NaoEPorta: Open, close, lock, unlock, tried while locked and revealed only happen if this wall is a door.

Area.Drawing: Area: the drawing's shape (it can be a hidden drawing, as an invisible zone).
Area.AmbientLight: Area: the light's reach (dim light radius).

Gat.NotaDica: Fires when someone clicks the note's pin (the journal opens as usual).
Gat.SalvePrimeiro: Save the object first to add a trigger to it.
Gat.RemoverPergunta: Remove the trigger from this object? Its configured actions will be lost.
Gat.AtravessarDica: Fires when a token crosses this wall's line. Tip: a wall that doesn't block movement becomes an invisible tripwire.
